description: This file defines the LoanScheduleCalculationPlatformService interface, which declares methods related to loan schedule calculations, updates, and generation within the Fineract loan portfolio module.

classes.name: LoanScheduleCalculationPlatformService
classes.description: An interface declaring methods for calculating, updating, and generating loan schedules.

methods.name: calculateLoanSchedule
methods.description: Calculates the loan schedule based on provided query parameters, with optional validation.

methods.name: updateFutureSchedule
methods.description: Updates the schedule for future installments based on provided loan schedule data and loan ID.

methods.name: generateLoanScheduleForVariableInstallmentRequest
methods.description: Generates a loan schedule for requests involving variable installments, based on loan ID and JSON input.
